name: Chichiiro Koi Moyou
source:
1 year has passed since the rumor of a lewd girl appearing at school.
It's not like I wasn't interested I just didn't bother to try and find her.
When I became a 3rd year student, the rumor stopped. I wonder what happened?

I now have a girl that I am interested in... but it turns out that she is...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE183616.html]DLsite English[/url]]
